meta.purpose: The six personality profiles used as Study-3 human-evaluation stimuli. Each participant judges one trail per profile.
meta.provenance: Designed backwards from behaviour by experiments/rq3/design_personas.py: 600 sampled OCEAN vectors were rolled 20x10 cycles under the hand-authored scorer at selection_temperature 0.1, summarised in five observable channels (busy-place share, conflict-action share, cooperative-action share, move rate, location coverage), and the set was chosen to maximise the smallest pairwise channel distance. Hand-written candidates (rq3_persona_candidates.json) were rejected first: several OCEAN paths converge on the same trail, so author-distinct profiles were not participant-distinct.

selection.forced_seat: P6 seated with N >= 0.5 exempt from the noise cap

meta.description_rule: Descriptions name dispositions, never behaviour. The test is the verb: a PREFERENCE ('likes a crowd', 'shies away from crowded places', 'likes to roam') is a trait the participant must reason FROM in order to predict where the NPC goes, and is allowed; a BEHAVIOUR REPORT ('heads only for busy places', 'visits everywhere', 'moves between quiet and rough spots') restates the trail and is not — it maps onto tavern/market/arena with no inference in between, which would measure vocabulary alignment and inflate every condition including the agnostic control. Never name a specific venue or action. Each channel has a dispositional reading: busy-place share -> sociability, conflict share -> combativeness, cooperative share -> agreeableness, move rate + coverage -> restlessness vs routine.
meta.trait_coverage_note: O spans only [-0.46, +0.43]. High openness raises novelty seeking, which widens a profile's own run-to-run spread past the stability threshold, so no strongly open profile survives selection. Per-trait conclusions are correspondingly weakest for O.
meta.description_revision: 2026-08-04, two passes. First drafts were behaviour reports (「只往热闹处去」「走遍各处」「清静处和是非场之间来回跑」). Second pass over-corrected by deleting the social dimension entirely, leaving traits with no channel to reason toward. Final wording keeps sociability as a stated preference and drops only the trail-restating verbs.

preregistered_expectation: H6 is the high-neuroticism seat and the only persona above the stability threshold (channel noise 0.142 vs a 0.12 cap). Neuroticism enters the scorer as the softmax temperature, so a high-N profile is defined by unpredictable choice: its trails vary more between seeds than the other five. Its identification rate is therefore expected to be the lowest of the six, under every policy. Recorded before data collection so the result is a test rather than an explanation.
